text:
emma-people: Quick one  - New hire (hybrid) starts 11/10 at 0.8 FTE for a 1-year fixed term. Manager asked how PTO accrual will be prorated, whether unused days at year-end can be carried to next year if they convert to full-time, and whether we can pre-approve a single holiday swap during the year-end blackout.

rick-hrbp: Policy summary: fixed-term employees are treated as employees for PTO accrual if on payroll (W2) vs contractors (1099). Proration = base full-time accrual * FTE factor, calculated monthly. If they convert to FT before year-end, accruals are recalculated pro rata and we can grant carryover per policy. If they remain fixed-term and leave at term end, carryover is not automatic.

jasmin-engineering: Manager note: hiring team wants to guarantee they can take Dec 23 as a holiday (family travel). Were flexible with coverage. Can we pre-approve and mark as exception so they can book travel?

emma-people: Two routes: (A) Approve a pre-authorized unpaid day (no policy change) and document in HRIS; or (B) approve as a comp-day swap if another teammate covers a shift during blackout; comp-day requires payroll entry. For hires starting mid-November, accrual through Dec is small; likely they won't have full-day balance.

payroll-bot: To record a comp-day or manual accrual override we need an email and minimal CSV. Example for comp-day: 

worker_id, reason, comp_date, pay_code
99012, "comp for holiday coverage", 2027-01-05, COMP-DAY

For accrual override: worker_id, action, days, note
99012, ACCRUAL_ADJ, 1, "pro-rated hire month + conversion guarantee"

Send to payroll@redwood.com and cc people-ops and finance.

rick-hrbp: Important: any exception during our year-end blackout (2026-12-20 to 2026-12-31) needs manager + People Ops sign-off in writing. If you want to guarantee Dec 23 off, manager should confirm coverage plan and we should add a note in the candidate file and HRIS before start. If you plan to convert them to FT later, include conversion date in the amendment so carryover calculation is clear.

calendar-bot: Reminder: Year-end blackout 2026-12-20 through 2026-12-31. Exceptions require People Ops approval.

jasmin-engineering: I'll have the manager confirm coverage and either: 1) request comp-day (teammate covers Dec 23) or 2) mark it unpaid. Which is faster?

emma-people: Fastest = comp-day email + CSV to payroll if teammate covers. If unpaid, just document in HRIS and candidate packet. For conversion/carryover guarantees, Legal + Finance sign-off needed before offer is finalized.

jasmin-engineering: Great, manager will confirm coverage in email today and we'll follow up with payroll CSV if they choose comp-day. Thanks all.
